text_ar_search:
وعنه أنه قال: قال رسول الله صلى الله عليه وسلم : 
"من علم الرمي ثم تركه فليس منا أو فقد عصى" ((رواه مسلم)).
text_en: 'Uqbah bin 'Amir Al-Juhani (May Allah be pleased with him) reported: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said, "He who learnt archery and then neglected it, is not from us." (Or said,) "He has been guilty of disobedience (to Messenger of Allah).".
